details: Ultragoal initialized for full IDE punchlist implementation. Starting Goal 1: Phase 1 Step 0 shared error helper and app token UI.

Implemented parseHttpError in src/services/httpError.ts with HTML leak prevention, refined formatActionableError regex in src/swarm/types.ts, and added masked app token UI with save/clear in SettingsModal.tsx. All 60 test suites (640 tests) pass.

Implemented runSwarm in-flight guard, AbortController setup with connect (30s) and idle (45s) timeouts, parseHttpError integration, SSE heartbeat in streaming.ts, Run Swarm disabled button in App.tsx, and unit tests in useSwarmExecution.test.ts. All 61 test files (643 tests) pass.

Refactored CortexDiagnosticsViewer with parseHttpError, calm app-auth card on 401, paused polling on 401 with resume on token update, safe metrics fetch, and guarded envStatus with null tolerance in useSwarmSettings and SettingsModal. All 62 test files (644 tests) pass.

Integrated parseHttpError in fetchAvailableModels without console.error leak, stabilized AgentConfigurator useEffect deps and deduplicated via useRef Set, added mounted cleanup, and rendered fallback text input with app token hint on auth failure. All 62 test files (644 tests) pass.

Removed silent 500k cut in useSwarmExecution.ts, implemented 500k data and 20k task char caps with live counters and over-limit button blocking in App.tsx, and added 2MB bodyLimit middleware to /api/swarm/stream and /api/swarm/analyze returning 413 JSON. Verified with vitest server 413 tests and full test suite.
Starting Goal 6: Phase 6 static routing and soft 200 prevention.

Added public/robots.txt, implemented mountStaticHandlers in server.ts with /assets/* retention, root static file delivery with proper MIME types, and restricted SPA shell fallback to GET/HEAD / and /index.html with 404 HTML fallback. Verified in src/server.test.ts and full test suite.
Starting Goal 7: Phase 7 extras (CSP cleanup and loud production Qdrant fallback warnings).

Removed duelodds.pages.dev from CSP connect-src in server.ts and src/swarm/server/app.ts while preserving CORS allowlists, and added loud NODE_ENV=production warnings in cortex.ts and learningState.ts for in-memory Qdrant fallback. Rebuilt dist and verified tests.
Starting Goal 8: Phase 8 Swarm CORS Before Auth (Section 2 / Section A) and feedback deduplication.

Extracted createCorsMiddleware in src/swarm/server/cors.ts, mounted CORS before createAppAuthMiddleware in server.ts to ensure 401/404/413 carry ACAO, guarded inner auth against duplicate checks, implemented (callerAppId, workflowId, pickId) feedback deduplication returning 200 {duplicate:true}, and added src/swarm/server/cors.test.ts (5 tests passing).
Starting Goal 9: Phase 9 verification checklist and full test suite run across all subsystems.

Executed npm test covering all 6 test suites: vitest (64 tests across 64 files passing), test:portable, test:simulation, test:dist (ESM & CJS), test:cli (8 sub-tests), and test:server (SSE, streaming, CORS, telemetry). 100% pass rate achieved with 0 regressions.
All 9 goals of the Perfect Swarm IDE punchlist successfully executed, verified, and gated. Blocked items (Tyler policy/infra) explicitly preserved without speculative code.
